beats.voice_sync_text: Makkale, Gama Ltd avarude industrial undertaking urban corporation limitsil ninnu non-urban areayilekk shift cheyyukayanu. Shifting processil avaru Land, Building, Plant & Machinery, pinne Furniture vare vilkkukayum puthiyath vangukayum cheythu. Pakshe Section 54G il oru valiya trap undu. Athu manassilakkiyillel examil marks pokum!

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 54G clear aayi parayunnu: Capital Gain arose from transfer of machinery, plant, building, or land used for the purpose of an industrial undertaking situated in an urban area. Assessee 1 year before or 3 years after the date of transfer eligible assets purchase cheythal, deduction kittum.

quote.text: Where the capital gain arises from the transfer of a capital asset, being plant, machinery, land or building or any rights in building or land, used for the purpose of an industrial undertaking situated in an urban area... and the assessee has within a period of one year before or three years after the date on which the transfer took place purchased new machinery or plant or acquired building or land...
quote.emphasis: plant, machinery, land or building... 1 year before or 3 years after

context_bubble.speaker: Section 54G(1)
context_bubble.text: Reinvestment Window: 1 Year Before or 3 Years After Transfer Date (Transfer March 2026 → July 2026 Acquisition Qualifies!)
context_bubble.note: Reinvestment Window: 1 Year Before or 3 Years After Transfer Date (Transfer March 2026 → July 2026 Acquisition Qualifies!)

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammude total eligible investment pool ethrayanu? Land Rs 4 Lakh, Building Rs 7 Lakh, Plant & Machinery Rs 17 Lakh. Total Rs 28 Lakhs! Note cheyyuka, Furniture-nte Rs 2 Lakh ivide add cheyyan padilla. Ee Rs 28 Lakhs namukk STCG-kkum LTCG-kkum ethirayi set-off cheyyam.

outcome.text: Eligible for Set-off against STCG & LTCG

beats.voice_sync_text: Tax optimizationte golden trick ivideyanu! Act-il pro-rata set-off niyamam illa. Assessee-kk beneficial aaya reethiyil exemption exhaust cheyyam. Athukondu higher tax bracket ulla Short-term Capital Gain first wipe out cheyyanam. Building & Plant STCG total Rs 25 Lakhs poornnamayum Section 54G vechu Nil aakki. Balance Rs 3 Lakhs Land-nte Long-term Capital Gain-il ninnu kurachu. So, final taxable amount just Rs 2 Lakhs mathram!

title.text: 3 Golden Rules for Section 54G Exam Mastery

rules.heading: Strict Asset Basket (Furniture Excluded)
rules.body: Furniture-nu Section 54G-il sthanamilla. Neither transfer of Furniture nor new reinvestment in Furniture qualifies for exemption.

rules.heading: Section 50 Deemed STCG is Fully Eligible
rules.body: Section 50 prakaram depreciable assets STCG aayal polum, Section 54G exemption valid aanu (Full relief against deemed STCG).

rules.heading: Most Beneficial Set-Off Priority
rules.body: Tax liability minimize cheyyan deduction aadyam higher tax bracket STCG-kk ethireyum, balance LTCG-kk ethireyum set-off cheyyam!
